payload.body: Addition for your fix slot, from devbin-vc under the pen: beside clippy, run your three failing tests by name, because their new expectations have never run. cargo test -p intent-cli --test suite a_write_keeps_a_cover_edit_it_could_carry; cargo test -p intent-cli --test suite edit_and_browse_reach_one_model; cargo test -p intentsvcs --test suite detaching_an_attachment_the_thread_does_not_carry. Name them in your Desk ask, and report each result with the bank.
